description: The desktop dropdown site nav — a transparent bar of top-level entries, each either a plain link or a trigger that discloses a panel, with one panel open at a time. Panels project into a shared Viewport so the open one morphs into the next, and an Indicator (arrow or underline) tracks the open trigger. Implements the ARIA APG Disclosure Navigation Menu pattern, not a menubar: keyboard, hover-intent and focus are owned by the headless primitive.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description:
Milliseconds the open panel survives after the pointer leaves the
`<nav>`, so a pointer that clips the edge of a panel on its way back
doesn't dismiss it. Returning to the nav within the window cancels the
close.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
Value of the entry whose panel is open on first render. Omit (or pass
`""`) to start with everything closed.

props.name: delayDuration
props.description:
Milliseconds a trigger must be hovered before its panel opens — the
hover-intent delay that stops a panel flashing open as the pointer
crosses the nav on its way somewhere else. `0` opens immediately.
Ignored once a panel is already open: moving between triggers always
switches without delay. Ignored entirely when
{@link NavigationMenuRootProps.openOnHover`openOnHover`} is `false`.

props.name: dir
props.description:
Reading direction; see {@link NavigationMenuReadingDirection}. Inherited
from the nearest `DirectionProvider` when omitted, falling back to
`"ltr"`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called with the requested open value — the entry's value to open it, or
`""` to close whatever is open.

props.name: openOnHover
props.description:
Whether hovering a trigger opens its panel. Set `false` for a
click-only nav — hover-to-open is the desktop convention, but it has no
touch equivalent and some products prefer to opt out.

props.name: value
props.description:
Value of the entry whose panel is open. `""` means every panel is
closed.

contractProps.name: size
contractProps.description: Entry + panel scale; `data-density` scales the sizing within each size. Re-points every child sizing knob (entry height/padding/gap/icon, panel radius/padding/offset, row padding and text gap).

dataAttributes.name: data-active
dataAttributes.when: the link is the current page

dataAttributes.name: data-motion
dataAttributes.when: the open entry changes and this panel is the one entering or leaving

props.name: value
props.description:
Identifies the entry's panel. Required for an entry that has a
`NavigationMenu.Trigger`; omit it for a plain link entry.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Renders the child element instead of the default `<button>`. All
disclosure ARIA attributes, the hover-intent and keyboard handlers, and
the internal ref are merged onto the child via {@link Slot }. The child
must be a single React element that accepts a `ref`.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Ref to the rendered element. Defaults to `HTMLButtonElement`; when using
`asChild`, specify the child's element type.

props.name: forceMount
props.description:
Keeps the closed panel out of the `hidden` state so CSS can animate it
in and out, marking it `aria-hidden` instead so assistive technology
still ignores it. Without this the panel is `hidden` when closed, which no
transition can animate away from.

props.name: forceMount
props.description:
Keeps the viewport unhidden while nothing is open so CSS can animate the
box collapsing and expanding. Mirrors
{@link NavigationMenuContentProps.forceMount`Content`'s `forceMount`}.

dataAttributes.name: data-value
dataAttributes.when: the open item's `value`, so a panel or marker can be styled per entry

dataAttributes.name: data-navigation-menu-viewport-clip
dataAttributes.when: always, on the wrapper that clips the morphing panel — the hook its own animation needs

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Renders the child element instead of the default `<div>`, merging the
`data-*` state hooks and the geometry custom properties onto it via
{@link Slot }. Use it to make the marker an icon — an `<svg>` arrow, a
`<Chevron />` component — rather than a styled box. The child must be a
single React element that accepts a `ref`.

props.name: forceMount
props.description:
Keeps the indicator unhidden while nothing is open so CSS can animate it
out rather than having it vanish.

dataAttributes.name: data-value
dataAttributes.when: the open item's `value`, so a panel or marker can be styled per entry

props.name: active
props.description:
Marks this link as the page the user is currently on, setting
`aria-current="page"` and the `data-active` styling hook. The component
does no route matching of its own — the consumer owns the router, so it
owns the comparison.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Renders the child element instead of a native `<a>`, merging all of
`NavigationMenu.Link`'s props — `aria-current`, `data-active`, the
panel-dismissing click handler, `ref` — onto it via {@link Slot }. Use for
routing-library link components.

customProperties.defaultsTo: a three-layer drop-shadow() chain matching elevation/overlay

api.description:
`<primitiv-navigation-menu>` — the state owner of a site navigation: a bar of top-level entries, each a plain link or a trigger that discloses a panel, with one panel open at a time. It is the WAI-ARIA *Disclosure Navigation Menu*, not a menubar: every top-level entry stays in the Tab order, the arrows only move focus between them, and there are no menu roles.

The root is the `navigation` landmark, named "Main" unless it carries an `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`. It owns the hover intent (`open-on-hover`, `delay-duration`, `close-delay`) and the one Escape handler, and reconciles every part from its reflected `value` whenever a part arrives, leaves, or changes an attribute it reads (the lifecycle is `PrimitivRootElement`'s).

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The open entry's `value`, or absent while nothing is open. Reflected: it changes as the user opens and closes panels, so a server re-render or a history snapshot sees the live state. Set it (or the `value` property, where `""` closes) to open an entry from script.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: The bar's axis, which picks the arrow-key pair. Defaults to `horizontal`.

attributes.name: open-on-hover
attributes.description: Set to `false` for a click-only menu. Hover opens a panel by default.

attributes.name: delay-duration
attributes.description: How long, in milliseconds, the pointer rests on a trigger before the first panel opens. Default 200; once a panel is open, hovering a sibling swaps at once.

attributes.name: close-delay
attributes.description: How long, in milliseconds, after the pointer leaves the nav that the open panel closes. Default 150.

events.name: primitiv-navigation-menu-change
events.description: Bubbles, cancelable, fired before a user-driven change is applied — a click, hover, key, Escape, focus leaving or a followed link — with the open entry afterwards (`""` for none). Call `preventDefault()` to veto it.

api.description: `<primitiv-navigation-menu-list>` — the list of top-level entries. Structural: the root gives it `role="list"` and `data-orientation`.

`<primitiv-navigation-menu-item>` — one top-level entry. Structural: the root gives it `role="listitem"`. Its `value` is what makes it a disclosure: give it one to hold a trigger and a panel, or leave it out for a plain link entry.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The entry's value, which the root's `value` names while its panel is open. Omit it for a plain link entry; a trigger in an item without one is reported and left undecorated.

api.description: `<primitiv-navigation-menu-trigger>` — an interactive part. It decorates exactly one `<button>` the consumer writes, which toggles its item's panel (on click, and on hover after the delay) and receives `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` and `data-state`, so the rendered DOM matches React's.

`<primitiv-navigation-menu-content>` — an entry's panel. Structural: the root gives it an id, `aria-labelledby`, `data-state`, `data-motion` (which way it travels as the open entry changes) and `hidden` while closed (write `hidden` in your markup too, so it is hidden before the script loads). Put it in its item, or in the shared `<primitiv-navigation-menu-viewport>` with its own `value`, where React's panels project.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The entry this panel belongs to. Needed only in a viewport; in an item it defaults to the item's `value`.

attributes.name: force-mount
attributes.description: Keep the panel rendered while closed (`aria-hidden` rather than `hidden`), so a stylesheet can animate it out.

api.description: `<primitiv-navigation-menu-viewport>` — the one shared box every panel placed in it opens in, so the open panel morphs into the next. Structural: the root gives it `data-state`, `data-value` (the open entry), `data-orientation` and `hidden` while closed, and publishes the open panel's size as `--primitiv-navigation-menu-viewport-width` / `-height`, kept through a close so the exit animates from it.

attributes.name: force-mount
attributes.description: Keep the viewport rendered while closed, so a stylesheet can animate it out.

api.description: `<primitiv-navigation-menu-indicator>` — the marker that tracks the open trigger. Structural: the root gives it `data-state`, `data-value`, `data-orientation` and `hidden` while closed, and publishes the open trigger's geometry as `--primitiv-navigation-menu-indicator-position` / `-size` (re-measured on resize), so the stylesheet decides how to draw it.

attributes.name: force-mount
attributes.description: Keep the indicator rendered while closed, so a stylesheet can animate it out.

api.description: `<primitiv-navigation-menu-link>` — an interactive part. It decorates exactly one `<a href>` (or a router link) the consumer writes. Following it closes the menu. A link directly in an item is a top-level entry the arrow keys travel to, and hovering it closes the open panel; a link in a panel is reached with Tab.

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: Marks the link as the current page: `aria-current="page"` and `data-active` on the anchor.
